regime.label: Dealer short-gamma downside squeeze - a 3.6-sigma break with net GEX 14x deeper and no gamma flip left in the grid
evidence: -27.1 pts (-2.53%) to 1041.9 is 3.6x the 7.53-pt 1-sigma daily move and the largest one-day drop in the 12-session record; the 1069-1083 shelf that held 09-22 through 09-30 broke outright.

-2,605 baht/pt total net GEX versus -188 yesterday and +450 on 09-24: dealers are 13.9x deeper short gamma, cumulative net GEX never crosses zero anywhere in 960-1150, so there is no gamma flip in the listed grid for a second session - every strike amplifies rather than dampens.

+4,859 contracts of OI added today (8,432 to 13,291, +58%) on 7,172 lots of volume, 3.7x yesterday's 1,915, with the put/call volume ratio flipping 0.75 to 1.15 - volume, OI build and an IV move all confirm the flow is live, not stale.

+0.91 pts of ATM IV (10.57 to 11.48) is a strikingly muted vol response to a 2.53% gap: realized just printed 3.6x implied, and 11.48% still sits 2.22 pts under the 09-17 high of 13.70%, so vol supply is still absorbing the move.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1041.9 closed -27.1 pts (-2.53%), a 3.6-sigma move against a 7.53-pt 1-sigma daily, and left spot 18.1 pts BELOW the 1060 max-pain anchor - the first time in the record the anchor sits above price. 7,172 contracts traded (3.7x yesterday) and OI jumped +4,859 to 13,291, split two-sided: +526 puts at the 960 wall and +477 at 1040 against +440 calls at 1050, +434 at 1100 and +204 at 1150. Net dealer gamma deepened from -188 to -2,605 baht/pt with no zero crossing anywhere in 960-1150, so dealers sell into weakness and buy into strength across the whole grid. ATM IV rose only 0.91 pts to 11.48%, so the option surface has not yet repriced the realized range.
what_changed: Net GEX deepened 13.9x, -188 to -2,605 baht/pt, and the gamma flip stayed absent from the 960-1150 grid for a second session (1140 as recently as 09-29).
Max pain drifted 1070 to 1060 and is now 18.1 pts above spot, inverting the 8-session pattern where price sat at or above the anchor.
Open interest exploded +58% in one session (8,432 to 13,291) on 7,172 lots, the largest build and the largest volume print in the record.

Near-money walls migrated inward: the call shelf 1100 to 1080 (672 OI, 375 lots) and the live put shelf 1020 to 1040 (837 OI, 600 lots), while the 1,208-lot 960 put wall closed from 10.2% to 7.9% below spot.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: -41.4 pts (-3.82%) since 09-24's 1083.3 is the whole story: the series went from a long-gamma, range-bound back quarter to a short-gamma accelerant in two sessions. Net GEX ran +450 (09-24), +171, +360, +374, then -188 on 09-30 and -2,605 today, while the gamma flip walked 1130 to 1150 to 1140 and then out of the grid entirely - the sign flip on 09-30 was the warning and today was the confirmation. Max pain slid 1080 to 1060 and total OI nearly doubled (6,818 to 13,291, +95%), so this is fresh burden being parked, not an unwind of old positions. ATM IV is net -0.56 pts over the five sessions (12.04 to 11.48) despite a 3.8% drawdown, which is the key asymmetry: implied has compressed while realized expanded, and the 10.57% trough on 09-30 marked vol supply right into the break. With 89 DTE there is no expiry pin to lean on, no gamma flip to act as a floor, and the next real OI shelves are 1000 (663 puts) and the 1,208-lot 960 wall.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Short gamma with no flip in the grid means a break gets hedged WITH the move, so the defined-risk expression of continuation is a debit vertical from the 1040 put shelf down to the 663-lot 1000 strike rather than a fade back toward 1060 max pain.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 14.40 pts net debit (1040P 22.90 ask - 1000P 8.50 bid), 2,880 baht at 200 baht/pt; max gain 25.60 pts at or below 1000.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1060 - the max-pain anchor and the shelf that broke - voids the continuation read.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960
strategies.rationale: The 1,208-lot 960 put wall took +526 contracts on 598 lots today and is now only 7.9% below spot, so the cheap tail leg targets the next structural floor at a 7.5:1 payoff rather than paying for near-money premium.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 4.70 pts net debit (1000P 9.50 ask - 960P 4.80 bid), 940 baht at 200 baht/pt; max gain 35.30 pts at or below 960.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1040 (the 837-lot put shelf) removes the path to the 960 wall.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1080 / 1100
strategies.rationale: The counterweight if the break stalls: 672 call OI at 1080 and 1,065 at 1100 are both live (375 and 561 lots, IV +0.37 and +1.06) and sit 3.7% and 5.6% above spot, but short-vol payoff is negative-skew and dealers are short gamma above too, so this is the small-size leg, not the core.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 16.40 pts (20-pt width - 3.60 net credit from 1080C 10.20 bid / 1100C 6.60 ask), 3,280 baht at 200 baht/pt.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1080 puts price inside the short strike with dealers still short gamma above it.

S50Z26.prediction: The bias is lower-to-unstable while 1060 caps: with -2,605 baht/pt of net GEX and no gamma flip between 960 and 1150, dealer hedging amplifies in both directions, and the 7.53-pt 1-sigma daily understates the range after a 27.1-pt print. The 1040 shelf (837 puts) is the first test, 1000 (663 puts) the next, and the 1,208-lot 960 wall the structural floor 81.9 pts down. A close back above 1060 toward 1080 would invalidate it and put the 09-22 to 09-30 range back in play.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no execution is recommended. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1060 max-pain anchor as a tendency at most, and note that with spot 18.1 pts below it on 3.7x volume this already reads as max-pain failure rather than a magnet - do not fade the break toward it. The 25-delta skew of -3.16 is distorted by implausible ITM-side put marks (5.36-7.67% at 1050-1070 versus 11.48% ATM) and should not be read as genuine call-richness. Defined-risk is not risk-free: every max loss quoted above is a real outcome, and at 89 DTE there is no expiry pin to rescue a wrong side.
